dict.string: AirBridge finds and connects to your phone and other computers on this network to sync the clipboard, send files and share the keyboard and mouse.
AirBridge uses Bluetooth to tell whether your phone is next to this Mac, so calls ring where you are, and to connect to your phone like a headset so you can talk on calls from this Mac.
AirBridge sends your voice to your phone when you talk on a phone call from this Mac.
AirBridge asks System Events to show or hide the menu bar when you tap the menu bar shortcut on your phone.
